Green stem disorder reference matches well — green stems/leaves persisting in a field of mature brown plants. Now checking other candidates.
SDS shows chlorotic/necrotic patches in a green canopy — doesn't match. Now checking Bean Pod Mottle virus (can cause green stems at maturity).
Bean Pod Mottle shows leaf mottling, not the green-vs-brown field contrast. One more reference to check.

SCN shows yellowing/stunted green plants — not the mature-field-vs-green-strip pattern in the test image.

The test image is unambiguous: a strip of green, leafy plants persisting in a field of fully matured, brown/senesced soybean plants. This is the defining symptom of Green Stem Disorder.
